2.1.0: Added unit field to numeric values
Added new categories: LaundryWasher, Refrigerator, Fan, Thermostat, Battery
3.0.0: Benchmark catalog expansion. Admission rule: a device, sensor or mode that exists in Home Assistant domains or SmartThings capabilities counts as common-sense and may be added; off-premise web services and vague time anchors (dusk/sunset) are excluded on purpose.

Added 50 categories: AirCompressor, CalendarProvider, CarbonMonoxideSensor, Chamber, ChatProvider, ClothingCare, CoffeeMaker, ConveyorBelt, Display, Doorbell, ElectricBlanket, EmergencyStop, EnergyMeter, EvCharger, FeedDispenser, FlowSensor, GarageDoor, GasSensor, GlobalVariable, GrowLight, MessageSender, Microwave, Mower, NewsProvider, NotificationProvider, OccupancyCounter, PersonTracker, PetFeeder, PowerMeter, Printer, ProductionMachine, Projector, ProximitySensor, RangeHood, RfidReader, SafetyBarrier, SoilMoistureSensor, Sprinkler, StatusLight, SunProvider, TiltSensor, UvSensor, Ventilator, VibrationSensor, WaterHeater, WaterLevelSensor, WaterPurifier, WaterQualitySensor, WeightSensor, WindSensor

Added services to existing categories: AirConditioner.FanMode, AirConditioner.SwingMode, AirConditioner.SetFanMode, AirConditioner.SetSwingMode, Camera.RecordingState, Camera.StartRecording, Camera.StopRecording, WindowCovering.CurrentTiltAngle, WindowCovering.SetTiltAngle

Added enum members: AirConditioner.AirConditionerMode:dry, AirConditioner.AirConditionerMode:fan, AirConditioner.AirConditionerMode:off, Fan.FanMode:turbo, AirPurifier.AirPurifierMode:turbo, Humidifier.HumidifierMode:sleep, Humidifier.HumidifierMode:turbo, RobotVacuumCleaner.RobotVacuumCleanerMode:spot, RobotVacuumCleaner.RobotVacuumCleanerMode:edge, RobotVacuumCleaner.RobotVacuumCleanerMode:silent, RobotVacuumCleaner.RobotVacuumCleanerMode:charge, Siren.SirenMode:intruder, Siren.SirenMode:gas, Siren.SirenMode:test, WindowCovering.WindowCoveringType:curtain, WindowCovering.WindowCoveringType:shutter, WindowCovering.WindowCoveringType:awning, WindowCovering.WindowCoveringType:rollerShade, WindowCovering.WindowCoveringType:screen, Thermostat.ThermostatMode:dry, Thermostat.ThermostatMode:fanOnly

effects: every function service lists what it changes in the real world, using a fixed vocabulary ($effects_vocab). Direct effects only. Switch.On/Off inherit the effects of whatever category the switch is attached to ($switch_carries).
